title: "Animal and Plant Physiology"

::: {.callout-note}
## First teaching draft

Tutorials, lecture slides, exercises, self-check quizzes and classroom practical
activities are available. Live laboratory protocols, specimen resources and
official assessment details still come from the teaching team.
:::

How do animals and plants maintain function, obtain resources, regulate their
activities and respond to their environments? This course connects cells and
tissues to whole organisms, using comparisons, practical observations,
experiments and scientific literature.

The working scope retains an equal animal and plant balance across 15 ECTS.
It follows the documented predecessor course while the successor's formal
details are checked.

- [Start here](start.qmd) and follow the [ten-week route](schedule.qmd).
- [Course scope and learning goals](overview.qmd)
- [Animal physiology lessons](animal/index.qmd)
- [Plant physiology lessons](plant/index.qmd)
- [Practical work and communication](practicals/index.qmd)
- [Reading and evidence](references.qmd)

Practical work develops physiological understanding and scientific reporting.
The [data and files](downloads.qmd) support complete classroom analysis by hand
or calculator. There is no required R component; an optional worked example
reuses a familiar workflow from Intro Computing.
